name: session-compass
description: Tab title, pane and /sessions list showing where each session is: repo, branch, plan, stage, now, done, todo

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: Show the stage and plan in the status line above the prompt. Off hides the line; the tab title, the pane and the VS Code status bar still show where the session is.

session_tag.title: Session ID in the tab title
session_tag.description: clash (default): add a short session ID like [7b19a4] to a tab title only when another live session already has the same title. always: put it on every title. never: leave titles as they are. The footer matches tabs to sessions by title, so with never, two sessions with the same title can share a footer.
